'''March 2001 Smyrna tournament (10 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Champions Cards, Smyrna, Georgia on 10 March 2001. [[Charlie Herren]] won it. It is known from James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1878">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-smyrna-ga-03-10-01-champions-carrdsd1878/ smyrna-ga-03-10-01-champions-carrds], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 12 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-smyrna-ga-03-10-01-champions-carrdsd1878/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Champions Cards, Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]
